Messages.Author: Cooper
Messages.Body:
Hi there,

Is there time to use haven hunting after a marionette is blocked?

W

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
On Jan 13, 9:58 am, Cooper <wouterkuy...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi there,
>
> Is there time to use haven hunting after a marionette is blocked?

Sure. The Marionette'd vampire doesn't go back to the original
controller until after the action is over.

Haven Hunting begins a new combat; the action clearly isn't over yet
until that combat is resolved (since, for instance, the acting vampire
could play one of several 'S:CE and continue the action as if
unblocked' cards during the subsequent combat.)

> W

-John Flournoy
